report.summary: An incident occurred on 2026-10-10 starting at 13:31 UTC where order placements failed with errors like 'Please try again'. The root cause was determined to be a push notification campaign ('diwali_sip_offer') sent to 2.1M users at 13:30 UTC with a direct deep link to create new SIP orders. This generated an instantaneous surge in user traffic across mobile-bff and orders-service, overwhelming the orders-service executor queue (capacity 500) and leading to RejectedExecutionException errors, high CPU utilization, and transaction failures.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Push Notification Campaign Overwhelms Orders Service Queue

supporting.note: Push campaign 'diwali_sip_offer' sent to 2.1M users at 13:30 UTC with deep link to orders/new-sip directly precedes the traffic surge.
mobile-bff traffic spiked abruptly starting at 13:31 UTC, rising from baseline 1097 req/s to 2516+ req/s.
orders-service traffic surged simultaneously at 13:31 UTC, jumping from baseline 115 req/s to 748+ req/s.
orders-service CPU usage spiked from 27.42% to 89.09% starting at 13:31 UTC.
orders-service logged RejectedExecutionException: order-executor queue full starting at 13:32 UTC.
orders-service error rate spiked to 14.12% starting at 13:32 UTC, correlating with the executor queue saturation.
notification-service RPS remained stable without anomalies during the campaign.
notification-service error rate remained at 0.31% with no errors.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Routine Deployment of Market Data Service or User DB Triggered Upstream Instability

contradicting.note: A 50-minute delay between deployments and the abrupt 13:31 UTC traffic surge without prior anomalies makes a deployment regression far less likely than the direct push campaign trigger.
Traffic metrics show an explicit volume spike starting precisely at 13:31 UTC, matching the push notification timing rather than a gradual deployment degradation.

facts.text: orders-service traffic (RPS) and CPU usage showed an anomaly starting at 2026-10-10T13:31:00+00:00.
orders-service error rate and p99 latency anomalies began at 2026-10-10T13:32:00+00:00, with error rates peaking at 15.85%.
orders-service logs show RejectedExecutionException: order-executor queue full (capacity 500) starting at 2026-10-10T13:32:04+00:00.
mobile-bff RPS anomaly started at 2026-10-10T13:31:00+00:00 and error rate anomaly started at 2026-10-10T13:32:00+00:00.
A push campaign 'diwali_sip_offer' was sent to 2.1M users via notification-service at 13:30 UTC on 2026-10-10.
notification-service experienced no distress, errors, resource saturation, or latency spikes between 13:30 and 13:35 UTC.

assumptions: The push notification deep link successfully drove a large synchronized influx of users to open order forms simultaneously.
evidence_gaps: query_metrics(service=orders-service) failed: timed out after 0.3s after 3 tries
query_logs(service=orders-service, contains=Please try again) returned partial data

timeline.event: mobile-bff and orders-service traffic RPS and CPU anomalies begin
orders-service error rate and p99 latency spike, and RejectedExecutionException occurs

recommended_actions.action: Implement rate limiting or queue shedding mechanisms on orders-service to handle sudden traffic surges gracefully without throwing execution rejections.
recommended_actions.rationale: Orders-service executor queue became full (capacity 500) during the notification campaign surge, causing transaction failures.

recommended_actions.action: Establish cross-functional coordination and throttling between marketing/notification campaigns and backend service capacity teams.
recommended_actions.rationale: Uncoordinated broad push notification campaigns with direct deep links caused instantaneous traffic spikes that overwhelmed downstream services.

recommended_actions.action: Review and increase baseline resource provisioning or adjust autoscaling parameters for orders-service during high-impact marketing events.
recommended_actions.rationale: Autoscaler reached max replicas only later in the incident after queue saturation had already impacted users.
